source_batch.unit_label: BRBL C U02 MSMED Act: Distinguish the National Board, Advisory Committee and policy-support powers

facts.statement: Board examines development factors, reviews policies and recommends; meets at least quarterly and associates advisers without a vote. Advisory Committee has specified expert/government/association representation and recommends on classification and related matters. Sections 9-14 address development, RBI credit directions, procurement policies and funds.

payload.core_explanation_md:
The National Board is a policy and development forum: it examines sector conditions, reviews programmes, recommends improvements and advises on the statutory funds. It is not the dispute-resolution Council. Its head office is Delhi and it must meet at least once every three months. A person associated to advise it can join the relevant discussion without a vote.

The Advisory Committee supports the classification and advisory work under section 7, chaired by the Ministry Secretary with the specified official and association representation. Sections 9-14 separately enable development measures, RBI-guided credit policy, procurement preferences and funding. None of these makes every MSME application an automatic loan sanction.

self_check.prompt_text: Does the National Board decide an unpaid supplier invoice through arbitration?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. That dispute route belongs to the Facilitation Council framework.

payload.stem_md: A branch wants to explain why an MSME development provision does not guarantee sanction of every requested loan. Which explanation fits sections 9-14?

options.text_md: The Board must approve every branch credit proposal
options.explanation_md: The Board has policy functions, not individual branch sanction powers here.

options.text_md: Procurement preference and a bank loan are the same legal decision
options.explanation_md: Procurement policy and credit appraisal are distinct mechanisms.

options.text_md: The Advisory Committee replaces the RBI for credit instructions
options.explanation_md: Section 10 identifies RBI guidelines for credit policies and practices.

options.text_md: The Act provides development and credit-policy mechanisms; these are not an unconditional sanction promise
options.explanation_md: The enabling framework must be distinguished from approval of an individual application.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The enabling framework must be distinguished from approval of an individual application.

payload.stem_md: An invited technical adviser says participation at a Board discussion gives an automatic vote. What does section 3(7) indicate?

options.text_md: Participation always carries a vote regardless of membership
options.explanation_md: The provision separates discussion participation from voting.

options.text_md: An associated adviser may discuss the relevant matter but has no vote by that association
options.explanation_md: The statutory association power does not confer voting rights.

options.text_md: No outside adviser may ever join a Board discussion
options.explanation_md: The Board may associate persons for assistance or advice.

options.text_md: The adviser becomes Chairperson for that agenda item
options.explanation_md: Association does not replace the statutory Chairperson.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The statutory association power does not confer voting rights.
